name: Felacat
description: Felacat was the Felacatian homeworld. It was located in the Outer Rim Territories, and its inhabitants were cat people who would transform into tiger-like creatures when in hyperspace for too long. During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems laid siege to Felacat.
lead_paragraphs: Felacat was the Felacatian homeworld. It was located in the Outer Rim Territories, and its inhabitants were cat people who would transform into tiger-like creatures when in hyperspace for too long. During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems laid siege to Felacat.
